name: Pullback after an acceleration
idea: A run of at least the set size breaks the last swing high, pauses with a shallow pullback that holds the level and goes on beyond its extreme; a signal when price comes back to the area between the level and the pause and turns up out of it. The mirror below a swing low. Wrong beyond the level.

params.label: Swing size (the swing degree read)
params.help: Which swings are read: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history. Reference: 0.

params.label: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in
params.help: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in. Reference: 14.

params.label: Baston: acceleration at least this many average true ranges
params.help: The acceleration that breaks the level: at least this many average true ranges. Reference: 2.

params.label: Baston: pullback at most this share of the acceleration
params.help: Its pullback: at most this share of the acceleration. Reference: 0.333.

params.label: Baston: tolerated penetration of the level, in average true ranges
params.help: How far beyond the broken level the pullback may go, in average true ranges. Reference: 0.1.

params.label: Baston: signal on the turn out of the area, or on the touch
params.help: turn: the close back out of the area after price came into it; touch: price reaching the area.
choice_labels: The close back out of the area

params.label: Bars a pattern stays watched
params.help: Bars a pattern stays watched (after its pullback, its second low or its second rim). Reference: 30.

setup.long: PricePattern("baston", "up", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, acc_k=$acc_k, hook_max=$hook_max, pen_tol=$pen_tol, entry=$entry, expiry=$expiry)
setup.short: PricePattern("baston", "down", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, acc_k=$acc_k, hook_max=$hook_max, pen_tol=$pen_tol, entry=$entry, expiry=$expiry)

invalidation.long: PricePatternLevel("baston_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, acc_k=$acc_k, hook_max=$hook_max, pen_tol=$pen_tol, entry=$entry, expiry=$expiry)
invalidation.short: PricePatternLevel("baston_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, acc_k=$acc_k, hook_max=$hook_max, pen_tol=$pen_tol, entry=$entry, expiry=$expiry)
